falsification_conditions.condition: S&P 500 closes below 4,800 on any single day in the next 14 days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: The 76% pattern match to bottom_2024_aug assumed a higher low structure; a break below 4,800 would violate the August 2024 bottom's key support zone and invalidate the bullish reversal pattern

falsification_conditions.condition: VIX closes above 35 for 3 consecutive trading days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: A sustained VIX spike above 35 contradicts the BLOWOFF SCORE of 39, which signals complacency/late-cycle behavior; persistent fear indicates this is not a bottom formation but rather an accelerating risk-off regime

falsification_conditions.condition: 10Y-2Y Treasury yield spread inverts by more than -50 basis points and holds for 5+ days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: Deepening inversion beyond the August 2024 bottom's curve structure would signal a credit contraction/liquidity event rather than the soft-landing bottom pattern; this invalidates the macro bottom thesis
